newsitem.title: LATVIA: BUDGET SURPLUS UP TO 8.17 MLN LATS IN APRIL.
newsitem.headline: BUDGET SURPLUS UP TO 8.17 MLN LATS IN APRIL.

text.p: Latvia's state budget registered a surplus for this year of 8.17 million lats by April 24, the finance ministry said on Thursday.
Revenues amounted to 166.25 million lats and expenditure reached 158.079 million lats, the ministry said in a statement.
It also said that the total internal state debt was 142.06 million lats.
It was financed by the sale of 129.38 million lats worth of state Treasury bills and credits from commercial banks worth 11.35 million lats.
Latvia's government has pledged to balance its books this year and has introduced tough austerity measures to achieve this goal.
